The '''804.d Starslinger ion drive''' was a type of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Three of these powerful [[Engine/Legends|engines]] were mounted on each [[A-24 Sleuth-class scout ship|A-24 Sleuth]].<ref name="ETU" />
